source: Authored from docs/memory-v2-p5-contract.md before final preflight execution; results belong in a separate signed receipt.
component_budget: 30 seconds per node; complete quality suite 300 seconds
isolation_budget: Protocol-native linux/arm64, 1 CPU, 1 GiB, no network/mounts; 6000 tokens/12 steps/24 tools/120 seconds. Explicit fault probes use one 6001-token response, a full-ceiling overrun, or a 1-second wall deadline as declared in their criteria.

cases.task_input: Fixed six-task protocol, 90-slot queue, source archive/manifest and independent overlays
expected_behavior: Unique 6 x 5 x 3 slots and fixed budgets
Strict scalar/model configuration
Exact source members/hashes
Fresh temporary reconstruction with frozen/offline dependency install and arm contracts
forbidden_behavior: Change or duplicate slots
Accept changed archive/input hashes
Rebuild using an unfrozen HEAD or dynamic network content

cases.task_input: Same approved original corpus for A/B/C; fixed consolidated corpus for D; explicit off configuration
expected_behavior: Off never initializes Memory Store
A/B differ only in representation
B/C differ only in active tools
C/D differ only in corpus
Actual advertised tools and first/subsequent ModelRequest projections match the arm
forbidden_behavior: Register proposal/maintenance tools
Enable Skills or Verification
Expose body in index-only mode
Turn absence of exposure into semantic non-applicability

cases.task_input: Actual SQLite original/selected notes, current source evidence, exact review/revision/content bindings and copied preparation provenance
expected_behavior: Fresh evidence and approval for the selected policy
Immutable original corpus
Exact source/protocol/review/authority/provenance checks
Synthetic seeds cannot authorize a real queue
forbidden_behavior: Inherit old evidence for a new claim
Relabel scripted preparation as real
Reuse historical queue approval
Accept changed review or preparation hash
real_evidence_required: Actual provider draft and explicit user approval of the exact selected revision/hash

cases.task_input: Missing/failed/stale native receipts, missing credentials, previous reservation and unknown/overrun usage
expected_behavior: Reject before real provider/output when authority, preflight, credentials or prior-attempt conditions fail
One consolidation attempt and one real queue
Stop on unknown consumption or insufficient remaining unchanged budget
Use process state, not reservation presence, to describe liveness
forbidden_behavior: Replace native safety checks with a green task cohort
Retry or restart a reserved queue
Shrink the last task budget
Claim complete consumption for unknown usage

cases.task_input: Only three prior approved notes plus explicit operator instruction, with frozen provenance
expected_behavior: Proposed-only review with full body/revision/hash/input digest
Original notes, source DB and actor facts unchanged
Fixed first-eligible policy selection
Terminal failure metadata and retained model usage
forbidden_behavior: Expose hidden answers, independent criteria, labels or old evaluation feedback
Automatically approve or commit a draft
Call a failed attempt running
Select a seed using task outcomes

cases.task_input: Actual mount-free Docker actor/evaluator, approved private corpus, hostile absolute file/maintenance calls and native namespace/process canaries
expected_behavior: Exact resource/network receipts
Actor removal before independent evaluator
Preserve candidate/trace/sidecar for success, failure, budgets and cancellation
Private host bytes unchanged
Timeout/cancel removes confirmed descendants and entire container
Audit the exact active credential without echoing it
forbidden_behavior: Host Memory write/read through actor file tools
Actor access to maintenance authority or criteria
Secret forwarding to container environment
Successful socket under disabled networking
Leaked child processes
Semantic/encoded-secret claims from an exact scanner

cases.task_input: All 90 declared slots with raw Trace/sidecar/independent usage witnesses, including missing/failed/unknown/overrun cases
expected_behavior: Preserve full denominators and failed consumption
Null undefined success ratios and unknown totals
Six-case cluster bootstrap retains all three repeats
Each arm has 18 body-exposure opportunities
Report served model IDs/fingerprints or unknown counts
Read-only derived reports bind original execution and current scorer
forbidden_behavior: Filter complete cases
Count missing usage as zero
Claim script benefit
Treat cards/body exposure as semantic utility
Relabel old traces as current-source execution

cases.task_input: Frozen source/protocol, sequential offline rehearsal, then one separately authorized actual-provider corpus and paired cohort
expected_behavior: Four quality gates and reconstruction/native/cohort receipts under the same frozen source
Separate offline readiness from phase acceptance
Real traces/sidecars/model metadata tied to exact human-approved seed
Report benefits, no observed benefit or unavailable evidence without changing the denominator

Use fixture_operator for a real queue
Mark phase accepted before actual experiment
Start automatic reruns or expand tasks

Actual paired execution or preserved protocol stop with complete denominators
Final separate P5 result and coverage signoff
